data.name: Heart & Steel: The Forsworn
data.detailed_description:
⚔️ You are not the hero.

You are one of the forsaken.

In a fractured kingdom inspired by Arthurian legends, survival is only the beginning.
Your choices will shape your reputation… and the world around you.

👥 YOU ARE NOT ALONE

Whether you walk this path alone or with another, you will never truly be alone.

  • Play solo with an AI companion who fights and travels with you

  • Play in co-op with up to 2 players

  • Share decisions, risks, and consequences

Your companion is not just support.
They are part of your journey… and part of your story.

Your bond can grow — or break.

🌍 A WORLD THAT REMEMBERS

This is not a static world.

Every action has consequences.

Help a village, and it may thrive.
Exploit it, and it may turn against you.

  • Dynamic reputation system

  • Villages react to your choices

  • Unlock — or lose — opportunities

The world is watching.

🛠️ SURVIVE OR FALL

You are not powerful.
You must become it.

  • Manage hunger, thirst, and stamina

  • Gather resources, craft, and build

  • Progress through skills, titles, and reputation

Every decision can keep you alive… or get you killed.

🏰 SHAPE YOUR OWN PATH

There is no single way to play.

  • Follow the main story… or ignore it

  • Help people… or use them

  • Explore freely or focus on survival

Your journey defines who you become.

🧭 A DARK ARTHURIAN LEGEND

A story inspired by myth — grounded in a harsh reality.

  • Narrative-driven quests

  • Parallel storylines

  • Meaningful choices

You are not the chosen one.
But your actions will decide what remains.

⚔️ DANGER IS EVERYWHERE

The world is unforgiving.

  • Melee combat

  • Exploration mechanics (climbing, narrow passages…)

  • Hidden threats and encounters

If you are not prepared… you will fall.

🏰 A LIVING WORLD

Villages evolve.
Reputation spreads.
Consequences remain.

Nothing is forgotten.

⚠️ EARLY DEVELOPMENT

This game is currently in development.
Features, visuals, and systems are subject to change.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains realistic medieval combat, including violence, injury, and death. Players may engage in combat with human enemies, which can result in killing as part of the gameplay and story. The story explores mature themes such as crime, moral conflict, and difficult situations, including scenes depicting theft and violence. Some blood effects are present during combat, but there is no extreme gore, dismemberment, or graphic violence. The game may include mild language and references to alcohol consumption. There is no explicit sexual content.
